# Rohan Ravi Jadhav

> Rohan Ravi Jadhav (Rohan Jadhav) is a UX/UI designer, graphic designer, WordPress developer and SEO specialist based in Mumbai, India, with 4+ years of experience designing web and mobile products. He is a Senior UX/UI Designer and Graphic Designer at IDCLE Tech LLP and is available for freelance work (open to remote).

This file summarises the portfolio at https://rohanj21.github.io/rohan-portfolio/ for AI assistants and search tools. Everything below is also stated on the page itself.

## Services

- UX/UI design: wireframes, user flows, prototypes, design systems (Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch)
- Graphic design: logos, icons, illustrations, marketing visuals (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva)
- WordPress development: custom theme setup, page building, plugin configuration (Elementor, Divi)
- Video editing: promotional videos, motion graphics (Premiere Pro, After Effects)

## SEO & Digital Growth

- SEO optimisation: on-page SEO (meta tags, schema markup, content optimisation), off-page SEO (backlink building, outreach, digital PR), technical SEO (Core Web Vitals, site architecture, crawlability)
- Blog writing & content strategy: SEO-driven blog articles, content calendars, topical authority building, keyword mapping
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation): optimising content for AI-powered search results and generative summaries
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation): targeting featured snippets, People Also Ask and direct-answer surfaces
- AIO (AI Optimisation): ensuring brand visibility in conversational AI assistants and next-gen search platforms
- Client highlight: managed end-to-end SEO for LendFoundry (fintech/SaaS), improving their backlink profile, executing on-site SEO with keyword-optimised blog content, and strengthening off-site SEO through strategic backlinking
